newsitem.title: USA: H&R Block Q1 tax form fees rise 16.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: H&R Block Q1 tax form fees rise 16.9 pct.

text.p: H&R Block Inc said Friday its tax preparation fees in the 1997 first quarter rose 16.9 percent from a year ago, to $753.4 million.
The total number of returns prepared in company-owned and franchised offices worldwide increased 6.9 percent in the period, to 12.2 million.
U.S. returns prepared in company-owned and franchised offices grew 9.3 percent to 10.8 million.
H&R Block has nearly 10,000 company-owned and franchised offices in the United States, Canada, Australia and Europe.
The number of returns prepared and electronically filed by company-owned and franchised offices in the U.S. increased 19.6 percent in the first quarter, to 5.3 million.

Results in Canada were impacted by the government's elimination of certain income tax credits, which resulted in lowering many taxpayers' refunds to levels that were ineligible for discounting, H&R Block said.
Tax preparation volume increased 8.4 percent in the quarter in Canada, while the number of tax returns prepared decreased 1.3 percent.
